h1: Build a UGC Ad for TikTok From a Product Link
lead: Build a shop UGC ad for TikTok from a product link or one photo, with one reason to buy. Paste the product page or start from a photo. The script, a voiceover, captions, and a track you can post come back with the file.
summary: You leave with a UGC TikTok ad: one reason to buy, a vertical clip that opens on the sunscreen, a voice, captions, and a first file you control.

sections.h2: What a TikTok Ads Generator Returns
paras: You need one product and one reason someone would buy it. The first file is ready without a filming appointment on the calendar.
A peach cream tube at the seaside is a real shot. Pair it with a track shoppers still hear this week, and say how the cream goes on.
Record a short clip of your own voice if the shop should sound like you. Otherwise pick a generated voice and rewrite the line until you would say it at the counter.
A file you can publish. Captions, the tall shape, and a track from the ad music library come with the video. Send it to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram, or download it and post it yourself.
sections.alt: Adult woman applies cream from a plain light-peach tube to her cheek at the seaside.

sections.h2: From a Product Link to a File
paras: Three moves, and you have a tall file without a studio day or an empty editing screen.
Paste the page when it shows the sunscreen you ship. A tube page that leads with the cap and the size is enough. You can fix a wrong title before the job starts.
Or upload one photo and one sentence about the action. Save the price for the editor, where you add it later.
A sample you can echo: a hand holds a peach sunscreen tube over a notebook on a bright cafe table. Write that kind of sentence for your own tube.

A product link and a photo each have a door. Use [URL to video](page:url-to-video) when you start from the sunscreen page. Use [AI image to video](page:image-to-video) when you start from a photo of the tube.
You choose the actor before you write the line, so the words fit that person. A product-only frame works too. See the [actor library](page:ai-actors). There are 53 AI actors.
The person on screen uses the look you picked for the shop, and the tube stays the one in your photo.
Play the tall file on your phone, then put the price in the editor. The price has to match what the shopper pays. After that, publish to TikTok or keep the download.
A shop system can start that same job through an API when a new sunscreen listing goes up.

sections.h2: Why Skip the Film Crew for Version One
paras: The opening shows the cream doing something a shopper can recognize, while the tube is still in the frame.
A first version can be a hand smoothing cream from the peach tube across the back of a hand. That scene is ready without an influencer on the call sheet.
The second opening can be a different first line on the same cream photo. You get that line without booking another morning.
A shop that also sells in Mexico can keep the cream scene and replace the spoken line with Spanish. That is another file, and the scene stays the one you already approved.
sections.alt: Two adult hands spread white cream from a plain peach tube across the back of a hand.

sections.h2: How the TikTok Ad Gets Made
paras: The sunscreen tube is on screen in the opening, while the shopper is still watching.
Keep the sunscreen photo. For the next file, change only who speaks. A new first line is a different test, and it belongs in its own file.

Match the length to the motion. Six seconds fits one motion. Ten fits a short demo. Fifteen fits a simple sequence. Thirty fits a longer one. A video is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30.
Captions and the song live in this editor. When the words sit clear of the tube, this pass is done. A new shape, such as a square for a feed, is a separate job.

faq.q: How do I make a TikTok video ad?
faq.a: Paste a product link or upload one photo, and you get a tall clip with a voice and captions. This guide walks the sunscreen tube from that link to the file you post on TikTok.

faq.q: How do I make the TikTok ad look like my shop?
faq.a: Start from your sunscreen photo or page, pick an AI actor or none, and set the line, the colors, and the captions. The tube in the file should match the tube you ship.

faq.q: How long does a first TikTok ad take to make?
faq.a: You stay at the keyboard for one pass. Paste the page for the sunscreen, or upload the photo, and type the feel of the cream in one line. The tall file comes back with that spoken line. No one promises a clock time.

faq.q: How does a product page become a TikTok video?
faq.a: A page that shows the sunscreen tube can be the start. You write one sentence about the swipe, and you decide whether a person is in the frame. The file is tall, 9:16, and ready to check on a phone.

faq.q: What does a TikTok ad generator create?
faq.a: A tall file built from the product you already sell. For this guide the sunscreen tube is on screen and a voice says what the cream does. The studio day can wait until you know which opening people watch.

faq.q: Can these ads stand in for a traditional shoot?
faq.a: Use them when you are still choosing the opening. A filmed spot with someone you hired can stay the main film. The generated file lets you learn which first line people watch, before you book that day.

faq.q: What do I gain by making the TikTok ad this way?
faq.a: You find out whether the tube is a clear opening before you book anyone. The sunscreen photo you already have is the raw material. A weak opening shows up in the file, while the crew day is still unbooked.

faq.q: Can I aim different versions at different audiences?
faq.a: Yes. One file can speak to people who commute, and another can speak to people who work at a desk. Keep the sunscreen the same, and change who the line is for. Your ad account tells you which file they watched.

faq.q: Can I match my brand's look?
faq.a: Yes. A navy caption and your own spoken line are enough for a cream shop to look like itself. The file should still look like it belongs on a phone, with the tube large enough to see.
